mysteryShop.method: One AI assistant was given a buyer's brief and answered six questions from each vendor's own public website, naming the page behind each answer. One run per vendor.
mysteryShop.brief: A 40-person fintech choosing a BI tool: Stripe and QuickBooks connections, embedded dashboards where each customer sees only their own data, the yearly price for 40 users, SOC 2 Type II, a free trial, and own branding with customer sign-in.
